_comment: Phase 7 benchmark configuration. Each unit runs under each active setting. Results land at OUTPUT/benchmark/<tier>/<unit-name>/<setting>/

filesPerSetting: experiment.json   — run log: timing, tokens, subagents, model
score.json        — testbed output: all quality metrics
signature.json + dependencies.json + functions.json + template.json + analysis.json — (S1 only)

s1-pipeline.description: Full Code2Docs pipeline: Resolver (deterministic) + Explainer (complex tier only) + Synthesizer. All Code2Docs skills loaded. Model: claude-sonnet-4-6.
s1-pipeline.tools: Resolver (tools/resolve.mjs), Explainer agent, Synthesizer agent, validate, check-integrity, render

s2-llm-sonnet.description: Phase A path: Code2Docs skills loaded (angular-semantics, requirements-writing, migration-risk-flagging), no Resolver/extractor tools. Model: claude-sonnet-4-6. Invoked via /code2docs-analyze.
s2-llm-sonnet.tools: Read, Write, Bash (file reading only) — no Code2Docs extractor tools

s3-llm-opus.description: Same as s2-llm-sonnet but model: claude-opus-5. Run only if s2 underperforms (screenLabelCoverage < 0.7 OR specTitleCoverage < 0.7 on 2+ units).
s3-llm-opus.tools: Read, Write, Bash (file reading only) — no Code2Docs extractor tools

units.name: activate
units.whyChosen: Phase A anchor unit. HTTP interaction (activate call) makes it non-trivial despite small size. 3 spec titles for testbed. Prior Phase A baseline in examples/ for comparison.
units._note: Classify-unit says 'trivial' because the HTTP is via a service the resolver traces. Actually standard-tier behavior. Benchmark will reveal whether trivial classification matches output quality expectations.

units.name: login
units.whyChosen: Has a reactive form (rich state), 7 spec titles for testbed, small enough to run quickly but complex enough to have real behavior worth documenting.

units.name: post-update
units.whyChosen: Phase 5 anchor. 12 methods triggers Explainer in S1. 8 spec titles. Full pipeline exercised. Prior Phase A and Phase 5 results available for trajectory comparison.

s3Gate.description: Run S3 if S2 underperforms on 2+ units

s4BugFix.description: Token-limited self-correction pass after each experiment if bugs found
